# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Financial Statistics Workspace

**Purpose**: Author pre-implementation quality review validating requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, and edge case coverage across all workspace domains.
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///home/chi/repos/Financial-Statistics-Adminiculum/specs/001-financial-statistics-workspace/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Canvas & Interactive UX Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are the specific node interaction and drag-and-drop behaviors explicitly defined for adding, connecting, and deleting entities on the canvas? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the <200 ms reactive recalculation target quantified with an exact upper bound on dataset size and observation count? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are visual states (selected, computing, error, warning) and inspection triggers consistently specified across all atomic entity types? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define keyboard navigation, focus management, or shortcut requirements (such as Cmd+K for the NLP command bar)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for unguided canvas launch that explicitly forbid onboarding wizards, walkthroughs, or forced tutorials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-004]

## Financial Statistics & Computational Determinism Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK006 Are mathematical formulas and parameter boundaries explicitly documented for all core atomic estimators (SMA, EMA, Volatility, Quantiles)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the requirement for deterministic high-precision numeric representation (`decimal`) consistent between the specification, data model, and project constitution? [Consistency, Spec §SC-008, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the specification define expected computational outputs when an entity encounters flatline or zero-variance time-series data? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are boundary conditions and mathematical behaviors specified for division-by-zero, sample size smaller than window length, or negative variance attempts? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Can the "zero floating-point rounding degradation" requirement be objectively and deterministically measured in automated tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## AI & Dynamic NLP Tool Execution Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Are the exact JSON schema validation contracts and error responses specified for all dynamic tools actionable via the NLP entry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the specification unambiguously define the fallback behavior and UI indicators when the AI inference service is offline or unreachable? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the state snapshot and rollback mechanics for the single-action Undo capability fully specified for complex, multi-node canvas mutations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the NLP response latency threshold (<2.0 seconds) bounded by specific timeout and cancellation token requirements? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Are ambiguous, incomplete, or unrecognized NLP prompts defined with specific diagnostic feedback requirements rather than generic error messages? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Data Ingestion & Multi-Format Export Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are auto-detection rules and manual override options specified for CSV file uploads (delimiters, decimal separators, date-time formats)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003a, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK017 Are export resolution and rendering fidelity requirements quantified for PNG (minimum 300 DPI) and vector SVG outputs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the specification define page layout, section hierarchy, and clipping prevention rules for multi-page PDF analytical dossiers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the schema, versioning, and validation rules for the portable workspace manifest JSON format explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Data Model]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the specification clearly define how workspace topology and analysis job states are persisted to PostgreSQL versus cached locally in the browser? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Storage]

## Non-Functional, Governance & Boundary Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Are live external broker/exchange market data streaming and automated trade execution explicitly excluded from scope? [Boundary, Spec §Explicit Out of Scope, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK022 Are circular entity wiring and dependency cycle detection requirements specified with concrete UI error-flagging behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
